application.live_vocabulary: The live reader uses the policy's own words, unaltered: NOMINAL, WATCH, INSUFFICIENT. An earlier draft of this run used a private word, NOT_EVALUABLE, for the unreadable rule; it was dropped because v1.0.0 already names that condition INSUFFICIENT (a missing observable the rule needed), and a private fifth word in the report would be the exact drift this pin exists to prevent.
application.no_exoneration: A live NOMINAL is not a statement that nothing changed. On this record the policy's block floor sits above the entire range of the monthly block magnitudes, so the live column cannot discriminate here at all. The artefact reports that as a property of the two measurement layers, not as a clearance of the asset.
application.scope_of_a_live_state: A live state from this read covers three of the policy's five observability rules. observability_drop needs a level this cut does not carry, and the displacement rules need a second stream. NOMINAL here therefore means NOMINAL over what an observability cut can carry, and the artefact prints that scope beside the word.
application.shape: One cut, two readers. The trajectory rule and policy v1.0.0 read the same per-chip numbers, the same standardisation and the same monthly bins. Neither reader is derived from the other and neither takes precedence; the pair is the report.
application.thresholds_are_read_not_chosen: Every threshold in this file was written down before the read and is verified against the artefact at build time. Nothing in this run selects a threshold from the data.

pin.purpose: Two readers, one set of numbers. This file records the exact rules each reader applies, by value and, where the file is not the file under test, by digest. The prospective run verifies this file before it builds anything: a moved threshold fails the build rather than quietly moving the verdict.
